about: T10.10 reader inputs for the derived standings (roadmap option B). Written by backend/reader/derived_standings_integration_test.go from the reader's actual HTTP responses (SCOREARC_UPDATE_DERIVED_STANDINGS=1) and asserted by it (as decoded JSON); consumed by src/server/data/derivedStandings.test.ts, which derives the MLS overall and Leagues Cup phase tables from them and compares the result with today's ESPN-backed store over the same recorded payloads.

evidence.crosswalk: Provider team ids become canonical through the production seed (backend/config/teams.seed.json).
evidence.recorded: phaseMatches: the 54-match 2026 Leagues Cup phase (leagues-cup-phase-2026.json) through the Go scoreboard mapper and the ingester's writer. membership.mls: the recorded MLS conference tables (espn-standings-mls-2026.json) through the Go standings mapper and ReplaceStandings.
evidence.synthetic: membership.ligaMx: the recorded Liga MX club ids (liga-mx-team-ids-2026.json) as a zero-stat Apertura 2026 table, plus a second table repeating two of them. The test match UUIDs. The excluded window-edge, knockout, other-competition and other-season rows the test stores beside them.

phaseMatches.note: Orlando City SC win 5-3 on penalties
